summary: Kernel 7.2.12, iCalendar library security fix (CVE-2026-111269), firmware updater and Mutter touch screen crash fix.

changes.note:
This release adds the following features:

 * Add an instance ID for each Redfish HPE device class and target pair
 * Include if the machine is a container or hypervisor in the report data
 * Require libusb 1.0.27 when building the daemon

This release fixes the following bugs:

 * Add After=local-fs.target to fwupd.service to fix a CoreOS mount issue
 * Create a dbx device with version 0 when the variable is missing
 * Delete the efi helper when using fwupdtool reboot-cleanup
 * Do not show GPIO devices in the fwupdmgr emulation-tag device list
 * Do not truncate 64-bit values when exporting firmware as XML
 * Fix a small memory leak when installing dell-kestrel firmware
 * Fix the DFU footer size check
 * Ignore parent battery reports when updating the Jabra GNP child
 * Process all releases to set the version on a 2023-only dbx
 * Remove command aliases from bash-completion
 * Use absolute paths when sending the filename hint

This release adds support for the following hardware:

 * Pixart PID 38CA
